item.title: [ZEPPELIN-1313] NullPointerException when using Clone notebook REST API
item.description:
Server returns HTTP500 and a NullPointerException shows up in the logs when using Clone notebook REST API.
Moreover, the error message mentions LoginApi and not NotebookApi.

Note:The authentication is not configured on my server. If it is required to use the notebook REST API, the server should return HTTP403 and indicates it in the logs.

item.summary: NullPointerException when using Clone notebook REST API

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment:
Actually, this error only appears when the name of the target notebook is not given.
Probably minor, even though the log messages can be improved. The HTTP return code can be changed to 400.
When there is no name given on cloning a notebook, we should generate the name as "Note <NOTEBOOK_ID>" as we do in create notebook API.

GitHub user kavinkumarks opened a pull request:

https://github.com/apache/zeppelin/pull/1348

ZEPPELIN-1313 NullPointerException when using Clone notebook REST API

      1. What is this PR for?
        This fixes when the input json is empty for the clone notebook REST API and for this case the default name will be populated.
      1. What type of PR is it?
        Bug Fix
      1. Todos
        NA
      1. What is the Jira issue?
        https://issues.apache.org/jira/browse/ZEPPELIN-1313
      1. How should this be tested?
        When the input json is empty for the clone notebook REST API, the response should be 201 with the default name populated.
      1. Screenshots (if appropriate)
      1. Questions:
  • Does the licenses files need update? No
  • Is there breaking changes for older versions? No
  • Does this needs documentation? No

set the default name for the case.Added test cases too.
